decision.summary: Keep the current Tier 0 labels as reduced-demo lesson vocabulary, but do not run another automatic recognizer or Detector 0 training job from this PopSign-only evidence. The next useful step is a human data/source scope decision: reauthorize first-party collection, approve a specific source/phonology artifact path, or accept the reduced learn-only claim.

current_tier0_vocabulary.reason: The set remains useful for the honest learn-only demo and for explaining the current model boundary, but repeated train-fit versus held-out failures do not justify model-card, browser, threshold, or final-readiness promotion.

m3ae_k_split_diagnostic.label_set_remediation_ruled_down: Label fragility is visible, but zero-recall labels rotate across validation and test rather than isolating one unusable label.

reselect_cleaner_popsign_tier0.why: The current failure is not isolated to one unusable label. M3AE-K found a source/signer distribution gap with no split leakage, and the M3AH CUDA run still underperformed after uncapping train and validation batches. A blind five-label reselection risks another training loop without new data or a stronger source rationale.
required_before_reconsidering: explicit gate that prevents another broad trial-and-error training loop

add_source_reviewed_phonology_or_reranki.why: This remains a plausible analysis-only next path, but the source register does not currently approve ASL-LEX/SemLex video use, and GOAL.md requires source-register evidence plus a vocabulary-overlap artifact before using phonology/reranking to change training choices.
allowed_later_without_media_import: write a source-register-safe ASL-LEX/SemLex vocabulary-overlap artifact
use database/metadata fields only if the source register explicitly permits that exact use
do not save or use sign reference videos without explicit approval

collect_first_party_clips.why: First-party collection is the cleanest way to control signer, capture, and vocabulary distribution, but it requires explicit human consent/capture work and cannot be performed autonomously in this slice.
required_before_reconsidering: human reauthorization of first-party browser-capture data
signed/recorded consent and clip-level review evidence
collection readiness audits before manifest export

stop_with_reduced_claim.why: The reduced learn-only product claim is already documented and honest, while the current ML lane has not produced promotable held-out metrics. Continuing automatically would require either human data collection, a source approval/overlap decision, or another speculative training loop.

popsign_v1_original_videos.current_decision: retain for reduced demo and evidence context; do not run another blind PopSign-only training job

asl_lex.current_decision: candidate-only for future source-register-safe phonology/vocabulary overlap work; no video use

asl_citizen_school_assignment_raw_videos.current_decision: not selected in this slice; would need an exact vocabulary-overlap/import artifact and no pretrained/pose-derived artifacts

wlasl_school_assignment_raw_videos.current_decision: not selected in this slice; would need current URL availability, exact vocabulary overlap, and raw-video-only import evidence

first_party_browser_consent_capture.current_decision: best controlled-data option if the human reauthorizes collection and consent/review gates are completed

brev_status.blocker: Brev still reports asl-pilot-rawframe-001 / 2hl1hytty as RUNNING after the documented stop attempts. Do not delete or reset the worker without explicit human approval.
